question: If one interior angle of a regular polygon is greater than its exterior angle by 144°, how many sides does the polygon have?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of interior and exterior angles of a regular polygon is always 180°.

Given the difference between the interior and exterior angle is 144°.

Exterior Angle = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (180° − 144°) ÷ 2 = 18°

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior Angle

⇒ n = 360° ÷ 18° = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 sides.**
